description_en: Queries the alert notification delivery history in a specified workspace by using paging, and supports filtering by conditions such as notification channel, alert severity, subscription, alert rule, recipient, delivery result, and time range
description_zh: 分页查询指定工作空间下的告警通知发送历史记录，支持按通知渠道、告警级别、订阅、告警规则、接收人、发送结果、时间范围等条件筛选
name: ListUserNotifyHistories

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Used to retrieve the next page of data. It is an opaque string generated and encrypted by the server. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query. For subsequent queries, pass the token returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记。用于获取下一页数据，为服务端加密生成的不透明字符串；首次查询无需传入，翻页时从上次响应中原样带回
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大记录条数。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间标识
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en:
The notification delivery type. Valid values:
SUBSCRIBE: subscription notifications
DIRECT: direct event notifications
ITSM: ticket or action notifications
parameters.help_zh: 通知发送类型。取值：SUBSCRIBE（订阅通知）、DIRECT（直接事件通知）、ITSM（工单/动作类通知）
parameters.name: send_type

parameters.help_en:
The notification channel. Valid values:
ALI_YUNGE_SMS: text message
ALI_YUNGE_CALL: voice call
ALI_YUNGE_MAIL: email
ALI_YUNGE_ALIUID: internal message
DING: DingTalk
DING_COOL_APP: DingTalk Cool App
FEISHU: Lark
WEIXIN: WeCom
SLACK: Slack
TEAMS: Teams
PAGERDUTY: PagerDuty
WEBHOOK: custom webhook
ALIYUN_SLS: Simple Log Service
ALIYUN_FC: Function Compute
ALIYUN_FC3: Function Compute 3.0
ALIYUN_MNS: Message Service
ALIYUN_OOS: CloudOps Orchestration Service
ALIYUN_ESS: elastic scaling
ALIYUN_EB: event bus
ALIYUN_OPENAPI: OpenAPI
parameters.help_zh: 通知渠道。取值：ALI_YUNGE_SMS（短信）、ALI_YUNGE_CALL（电话）、ALI_YUNGE_MAIL（邮件）、ALI_YUNGE_ALIUID（站内信）、DING（钉钉）、DING_COOL_APP（钉钉酷应用）、FEISHU（飞书）、WEIXIN（企业微信）、SLACK（Slack）、TEAMS（Teams）、PAGERDUTY（PagerDuty）、WEBHOOK（自定义Webhook）、ALIYUN_SLS（日志服务）、ALIYUN_FC（函数计算）、ALIYUN_FC3（函数计算3.0）、ALIYUN_MNS（消息服务）、ALIYUN_OOS（运维编排）、ALIYUN_ESS（弹性伸缩）、ALIYUN_EB（事件总线）、ALIYUN_OPENAPI（OpenAPI）
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en:
The alert severity. Valid values:
CRITICAL: critical
ERROR: error
WARNING: warning
INFO: information
parameters.help_zh: 告警级别。取值：CRITICAL（严重）、ERROR（错误）、WARNING（警告）、INFO（信息）
parameters.name: severity

parameters.help_en: The subscription ID. Used to filter the notification history for a specified subscription. It is a 32-character string
parameters.help_zh: 订阅ID。用于筛选指定订阅的通知历史，为32位字符串
parameters.name: subscription_id

parameters.help_en: The subscription name. Used to filter the notification history by subscription name
parameters.help_zh: 订阅名称。用于按订阅名称筛选通知历史
parameters.name: subscription_name

parameters.help_en: The alert rule ID. Used to filter the notification history triggered by a specified alert rule. Exact match is applied
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则ID。用于筛选指定告警规则触发的通知历史（精确匹配）
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: The alert rule name. Used to filter the notification history by rule name
parameters.help_zh: 告警规则名称。用于按规则名称筛选通知历史
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The recipient. Used to filter the notification history by recipient address, such as a phone number, email address, or webhook URL
parameters.help_zh: 接收人。用于按接收地址筛选通知历史，如手机号、邮箱或Webhook地址
parameters.name: receiver

parameters.help_en: The contact group. Used to filter the notification history by contact group name
parameters.help_zh: 联系人组。用于按联系人组名称筛选通知历史
parameters.name: group

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Default value: 6 hours before the `to` parameter value
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始时间，Unix秒级时间戳。默认值：to 前 6 小时
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Default value: the current time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，Unix秒级时间戳。默认值：当前时间
parameters.name: to

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to filter by delivery result. Valid values:
true: Only successfully delivered records are returned.
false: Only failed delivery records are returned.
If you do not specify this parameter, the results are not filtered by delivery result
parameters.help_zh: 是否按发送结果筛选。取值：true（仅返回发送成功的记录）、false（仅返回发送失败的记录）。不传则不按发送结果筛选
parameters.name: success

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to sort the results in descending order of time. Valid values:
true: The results are sorted in descending order, with the latest records appearing first.
false: The results are sorted in ascending order.
Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否按时间倒序排列。取值：true（倒序，最新在前）、false（正序）。默认值：true
parameters.name: is_desc

parameters.help_en: The notification batch ID. Used to filter the notification history for notifications delivered in the same batch
parameters.help_zh: 通知批次ID。用于筛选同一批次发送的通知历史
parameters.name: batch_id

parameters.help_en:
The channel category. Valid values:
WEBHOOK: webhook-based channels, such as DingTalk, Lark, WeCom, Slack, Teams, and custom webhooks
YUNGE: Yunge communication channels, such as text messages, voice calls, and emails
parameters.help_zh: 渠道类别。取值：WEBHOOK（Webhook 类渠道，如钉钉、飞书、企业微信、Slack、Teams、自定义 Webhook 等）、YUNGE（云歌通信类渠道，如短信、电话、邮件）
parameters.name: channel_category

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include notification records that have no actual delivery channel. Valid values:
true: The records are included.
false: The records are not included. Only records that were actually delivered through a channel are returned.
Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否包含无实际发送渠道的通知记录。取值：true（包含）、false（不包含，仅返回实际发送过渠道的记录）。默认值：true
parameters.name: include_no_channel

parameters.help_en: The incident ID. Used to filter the notification history associated with a specified incident
parameters.help_zh: 事件（Incident）ID。用于筛选指定事件关联的通知历史
parameters.name: incident_id

parameters.help_en: The notification policy name. Used to filter the notification history by notification policy name
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略名称。用于按通知策略名称筛选通知历史
parameters.name: notify_strategy_name

parameters.help_en: The notification policy ID. Used to filter the notification history for a specified notification policy. It is a 32-character string
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略ID。用于筛选指定通知策略的通知历史，为32位字符串
parameters.name: notify_strategy_id

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This is an internal reserved parameter used only for dedicated notification history query paths in internal platform scenarios. Do not pass this parameter in external calls
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃（deprecated）的内部保留参数，仅用于平台内部场景的通知历史专用查询路径，外部调用方请勿传入
parameters.name: partition_key

parameters.help_en: [Deprecated] This is an internal reserved parameter used only for business source filtering in internal platform scenarios. Do not pass this parameter in external calls
parameters.help_zh: 已废弃（deprecated）的内部保留参数，仅用于平台内部场景的业务来源过滤，外部调用方请勿传入
parameters.name: biz_source

channel.description_en: The notification channel. The valid values are the same as those of the `channel` request parameter
channel.description_zh: 通知渠道，取值同请求参数 channel

contacts.description_en: The list of contacts. Multiple contacts are separated by commas
contacts.description_zh: 联系人列表，多个联系人以逗号分隔

groups.description_en: The list of contact groups. Multiple contact groups are separated by commas
groups.description_zh: 联系人组列表，多个联系人组以逗号分隔

noChannel.description_en:
Indicates whether the notification record has no actual delivery channel. Valid values:
true: The notification record has no actual delivery channel, and the notifyResult is NO_CHANNEL.
false: The notification record has an actual delivery channel
noChannel.description_zh: 是否为无实际发送渠道的通知记录。取值：true（无渠道，即 notifyResult 为 NO_CHANNEL）、false（有实际发送渠道）

receiver.description_en: The recipient address, such as a phone number, email address, or webhook URL, depending on the notification channel
receiver.description_zh: 接收人地址，如手机号、邮箱或Webhook地址，取决于通知渠道

result.description_en: The notification delivery result details. This is the raw response content returned by the channel, such as the API response from a DingTalk or Lark bot
result.description_zh: 通知发送结果详情，为渠道返回的原始响应内容（如钉钉/飞书机器人的API响应）

sendType.description_en:
The notification delivery type. Valid values:
SUBSCRIBE: subscription notifications
DIRECT: direct event notifications
ITSM: ticket or action notifications
sendType.description_zh: 通知发送类型。取值：SUBSCRIBE（订阅通知）、DIRECT（直接事件通知）、ITSM（工单/动作类通知）

severity.description_en:
The alert severity. Valid values:
CRITICAL: critical
ERROR: error
WARNING: warning
INFO: information
severity.description_zh: 告警级别。取值：CRITICAL（严重）、ERROR（错误）、WARNING（警告）、INFO（信息）

status.description_en:
The incident status. Valid values:
TRIGGERED: triggered
RESOLVED: resolved
ACK: acknowledged
ESCALATED: escalated
MANUAL_RESOLVED: manually resolved
TIMEOUT: automatically resolved due to timeout
RETRIGGERED: retriggered
PARTIAL_RESOLVED: partially resolved
INVALID: invalid
status.description_zh: 事件状态。取值：TRIGGERED（触发）、RESOLVED（恢复）、ACK（已确认）、ESCALATED（升级）、MANUAL_RESOLVED（手动解决）、TIMEOUT（超时自动恢复）、RETRIGGERED（重复提醒）、PARTIAL_RESOLVED（部分恢复）、INVALID（无效）

success.description_en:
Indicates whether the notification was delivered successfully. Valid values:
true: The notification was delivered successfully.
false: The notification delivery failed
success.description_zh: 通知是否发送成功。取值：true（成功）、false（失败）

timestamp.description_en: The time when the notification record was generated. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds
timestamp.description_zh: 通知记录时间，Unix秒级时间戳

userId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID to which the notification record belongs
userId.description_zh: 通知记录归属的阿里云账号ID

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned by this request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录条数
maxResults.title_en: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
maxResults.title_zh: MaxResults本次请求所返回的最大记录条数

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token for the next page. It is an opaque string generated and encrypted by the server. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页分页标记，为服务端加密生成的不透明字符串；为空表示无更多数据

total.description_en: The total number of notification history entries that meet the query conditions
total.description_zh: 满足查询条件的通知历史总条数
